answer: Proof-of-Space-Time curbs a tide of Sybil identities in agent networks auditing jade provenance or prism optics. Each agent seals a unique, key-derived hash graph on disk and answers beacon-seeded Merkle challenges within strict deadlines. This forces attackers to dedicate scarce, non-shareable physical storage per identity. However, adversaries with fast processors can exploit space-time tradeoffs to recompute unstored slices on demand if audit windows are too wide.
